_detector_exclusion_rationale.incorrect-equality: ClaimRush uses intentional strict equality checks for wiring validation (address == expected) and mode enums; false positives dominate
_detector_exclusion_rationale.unused-return: SafeERC20 and SafeTransfer wrappers handle return values internally; raw ERC20 calls are banned by semgrep sol-unchecked-transfer rule
_detector_exclusion_rationale.too-many-digits: Large literal constants (1e18, 10_000e18, etc.) are intentional and match spec-defined values; Solidity underscore separators already improve readability
